svg.title: 42 years of KPV, and no published trial in people
svg.desc: Timeline. 1984 rabbit fever study. 1989 mouse ear-swelling test. 1991 U.S. patent assigned to the University of Texas System, with a human dose derived from hydrocortisone. 2002 Zengen files to test CZEN-002, a KPV dimer. 2004 open-label study in 20 women with vaginal yeast infection, then nothing further published. 2005 skin patent issues, with two anecdotal human cases. 2008 mouse colitis studies at Emory and Münster. 2017 lab test on donated human skin finds plain KPV does not pass through. 2021 Wells Pharmacy Network nominates a 0.1% KPV cream. 2026 FDA staff recommend against, advisers vote 8-6-1 in favor, and an interim policy goes to the White House.
